### libraries

```{r}
# library code will go here (will eventually be moved to and R-script)

# libraries we'll be using
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(Lahman) # specific data set for the app (baseball data)

data("LahmanData", package = "Lahman")
```

### ui

```{r}
# UI code is gonna go here for now (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# ui/display code here
ui <- page_sidebar(
  
  # code for the title of the page
  title = "Baseball Data and Analytics — Courtesy of the Lahman Package",
  
  # sidebar code
  sidebar = sidebar(
    position = "right",
    
    # year selection first  
    selectInput(
      "sidebar_choice",
      "Select a Year to View:",
      choices = sort(Lahman::Teams$yearID, decreasing = TRUE)
    ),
    
    # team selection second (choices get updated from server)
    selectizeInput(
      "team_choice",
      "Choose a Team to View:",
      choices = NULL,
      options = list(placeholder = "Select a year first")
    ),

    # stat/metric (choices get updated from server)
    selectizeInput(
      "stat_choice",
      "Select Stat to View:",
      choices = NULL,
      options = list(placeholder = "Select a team first")
    )
  ),
  
  # main page / card code here
  card(
    card_header(uiOutput("card_title")),
    card_body(uiOutput("card_body"))
  )
)
```

### server

```{r}
# server code is gonna go here for now (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# server/back end code for the app
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # filter Teams by selected year
  teams_year <- reactive({
    req(input$year_choice)
    subset(Lahman::Teams, yearID == input$year_choice)
  })

  # when year changes -> update team choices
  observeEvent(input$year_choice, {
    df <- teams_year()

    # readable labels, stable values
    team_labels <- paste0(df$name, " (", df$teamID, ")")
    team_values <- df$teamID
    names(team_values) <- team_labels

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "team_choice",
      choices = team_values,
      selected = character(0),
      server = TRUE
    )

    # clear stats until a team is chosen
    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "stat_choice",
      choices = character(0),
      selected = character(0),
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  # stats available for selected year+team (numeric columns from Teams row)
  available_stats <- reactive({
    req(input$year_choice, input$team_choice)

    df <- teams_year()
    row <- df[df$teamID == input$team_choice, , drop = FALSE]
    req(nrow(row) >= 1)

    # if duplicates exist, take the first row (edge case)
    row <- row[1, , drop = FALSE]

    num_cols <- names(row)[vapply(row, is.numeric, logical(1))]

    # remove IDs / fields that are usually not "stats"
    setdiff(num_cols, c("yearID"))
  })

  # when team changes update stat choices
  observeEvent(input$team_choice, {
    stats <- available_stats()

    # pick a sensible default if present
    default_stat <- if ("W" %in% stats) "W" else stats[1]

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "stat_choice",
      choices = stats,
      selected = default_stat,
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  # reactive card title
  output$card_title <- renderUI({
    req(input$year_choice, input$team_choice)

    stat_txt <- if (!is.null(input$stat_choice) && nzchar(input$stat_choice)) {
      paste0(" | Stat: ", input$stat_choice)
    } else {
      ""
    }

    paste0("Year: ", input$year_choice, " | Team: ", input$team_choice, stat_txt)
  })

  # reactive card body (show chosen stat + a small preview row)
  output$card_body <- renderUI({
    req(input$year_choice, input$team_choice, input$stat_choice)

    df <- teams_year()
    row <- df[df$teamID == input$team_choice, , drop = FALSE]
    req(nrow(row) >= 1)
    row <- row[1, , drop = FALSE]

    val <- row[[input$stat_choice]][[1]]

    tagList(
      tags$p(paste0(input$stat_choice, ": ", val)),
      tags$hr(),
      tags$pre(capture.output(utils::str(row))),
      tags$hr(),
      tags$pre(capture.output(row))
    )
  })
}

```

### run app

```{r}
# code to run the app (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# runs the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server=server)
```
